entities.summary: The Alexandroupolis Mosque, also known as the Mosque of Alexandroupolis, is a mosque on Kassandras Street, in the town of Alexandroupolis, in Evros, in the Eastern Macedonia and Thrace region of Greece. Completed in 1906 during the Ottoman era, the mosque serves the small Muslim community of the town.
